audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 are marked 'Skill' although the prose on both layers says Kennen owns them, and the 2+ item row says 'Kennen' while every piece of prose (and the 9.5/10 carry rating) says Vayne takes over.
audit.why: Pre-6 Vayne has no all-in: Tumble is 300 range and Condemn is 20s at rank 1. At 6 Final Hour grants attack damage, invisibility during Tumble and move speed but no dash, so it does not break a Slicing Maelstrom lock. Past two items Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage ignores anything Kennen builds.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 = Kennen, Level 6 = Kennen, 2+ items = Vayne, with matching win[] rows.

audit.why: Spike shape is right: Kennen at 2-3, level 6 Slicing Maelstrom, first-item Alternator/Rocketbelt, Vayne from two items on. Vayne's own spikes are Silver Bolts stacking and Final Hour at 100/85/70s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is described only as 'wall-stun' with no cooldown, and the invisibility is attributed to Q alone.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s at 550 range — a knockback that only stuns on terrain collision, and the displacement can pull Kennen out of Slicing Maelstrom. Riot's Final Hour text grants 'Invisibility during Tumble', so the invis exists only while her ultimate is up.
audit.corrected: State Condemn's 20s rank-1 cooldown as the commit window, and tie the Tumble invisibility to Final Hour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tumble's auto-attack reset is not given as a read.
audit.why: The missing-interaction file flags autoreset-burst-tell: her burst opens with the reset, so the attack wind-up after the tumble is the cue, not the cast.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Condemn's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You keep the poke edge and she has no all-in pre-6: trade whenever Condemn is down, which is 20 seconds at rank 1, and bank the chip.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom + Zhonya wins any grouped fight top-side. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks her no-MR body and Final Hour grants her no dash to break it — E-Flash in and she dies before she kites.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in and Silver Bolts' true damage ignores the HP you bought while Final Hour hides her Tumble — group and R, never sidelane.

edits.before: You're both weak at level 1 — one Q poke and Surge autos chip, but with no stun you don't commit into her tumble reset.
edits.after: You're both weak at level 1 — one Q chips, but with no stun don't commit: Tumble (Q) is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: She out-scales hard: W true damage ignores your HP and Q invis kites you while your R sits on cooldown — play safe and let your team peel.
edits.after: She out-scales hard: Silver Bolts' true damage ignores your HP and Final Hour hides her Tumble while your R sits on a 120s cooldown.

edits.before: Past two items her W true damage and Q invis kite you forever — your R is on cooldown and she shreds your squishy body.
edits.after: Past two items Silver Bolts' true damage and Final Hour's Tumble invisibility kite you forever while your 120s R is down.

edits.before: Past two items the lane flips and you cannot stop it. Her W Silver Bolts deal percent-max-HP true damage that ignores any HP you stack, her Q gives invis to break your target lock, and her Condemn pins you while she kites — and your squishy caster body folds the moment your R is on cooldown. Your only answer is to have already won: close the game on your 6/first-item spike, take plates and skirmishes top-side, and pivot to a teamfight engager. If it goes long, never sidelane her 1v1 — group and R the carries.
edits.after: Past two items the lane flips and you cannot stop it. Silver Bolts deals percent-max-HP true damage that ignores any HP you stack, Final Hour makes every Tumble an invisibility to break your target lock, and Condemn knocks you clean out of a Slicing Maelstrom channel. Your only answer is to have already won: close on your 6 and first-item spike, take plates and top-side skirmishes, and pivot to a teamfight engager. If it goes long, never duel her — group and R the carries.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wall-stun, 20s at rank 1. Engage only once it is baited or down.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — Stun-stack + R her.
edits.after: Condemn (E) is 20s at rank 1 and knocks you out of R — bait it, then stun-stack and R her.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' true damage ignores the HP you bought — refuse the duel.

edits.before: Burning E to engage with no stun counted — diving as a squishy yordle without CC ready is a coin flip you lose.
edits.after: Every minute she farms brings Silver Bolts and Final Hour closer — shove, deny, and end the lane early.

notes: The packet defect 'Land Thundering Shuriken' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Thundering Shuriken is Kennen's real Q name and the early text is correct. Level chart rows 3, 4 and 6 flipped as one atomic group in both layers to match the packet chart and the existing prose (rows 3/4 to Kennen, row 6 to Vayne, matching the 9.5/10 carry rating). Whether Condemn's knockback can be cleansed or is blocked by tenacity is not in the kit data and was not asserted.
